name: gh_search_code
description: Search code across repositories via the code index (GET /search/code)

q.description: The query contains one or more search keywords. Matched against file paths and indexed file contents.

repo.description: Limit results to a repository, owner/repo form (the repo: qualifier in the real API).

limit.description: The number of results per page (max 100). GitHub param: per_page. Default: 30.
